open_findings: No independent review of any module (MGR-07 not satisfied)
The blueprint's 374-item checklist remains NOT VERIFIED pending review; CHECKLIST_STATUS.md distinguishes test evidence from full acceptance
A basic lint/type/test CI workflow exists; deployment security, model lifecycle, data-governance and compliance controls remain unimplemented
Reference scenarios use synthetic single-asset GBM and separate economic/hedge balance sheets; price and policy response rules are not empirically calibrated
Black-Scholes marks and conditional risk freeze the closing rate; no joint stochastic-rate Q valuation or full dynamic-policy risk forecast is implemented

Deterministic macro time engine: calendar, seeds, point-in-time data, shocks (PR-003)
Classical GBM/Heston and macro-conditioned (non-neural) path simulation (PR-004/009)
Black-Scholes/Monte Carlo pricing (PR-005)
Historical/parametric VaR and Expected Shortfall (PR-006)
Delta and CVaR-trained MLP hedge simulation against synthetic paths (PR-007)
A first paired-bootstrap research benchmark (PR-008)
End-to-end demonstration and monthly StepHooks scenario with online delta/MLP hedging, conditional portfolio risk and evidence export (PR-011/014/015)
Government taxes/transfers/bonds and a scalar central-bank policy-rate agent (PR-012)
Single-firm labor/goods quantity clearing with ledger settlement (PR-013)
Reproducible benchmark/retraining stress recipes and exact artifact replay (PR-016/017)
Exact budget-feasible price discovery, inventory and atomic market settlement (PR-018)
Publication-lagged price/output policy feedback coupled to market and hedge financing with explicit opening/closing rate timing (PR-019)
Crossed retraining/shared macro-market banks across publication, payroll and supply-shock scenarios with conditional-CVaR diagnostics (PR-020)
Matched current-rate feature ablation with independent macro training banks, variable-rate differentiable accounting and optimization diagnostics (PR-021)
Synthetic instrument calibration, American/forward pricing and mixed position valuation; portfolio, covariance, factor and network-risk modules (PR-022..040)
Ledger-backed central-bank/interbank operations, causal risk circuit breaker and bank interest/write-off primitives (PR-026..043)
Empirical macro/market-mixture CVaR with paired nested resampling and retained terminal-loss provenance (PR-044)
Detached whole-artifact checksum snapshots, strict metadata/fingerprint validation, offline audit and complete 374-item traceability register (PR-045)
Allowlisted typed recipes, bounded local SQLite job queue, fenced Linux workers and no-clobber quota-controlled artifact publication (PR-046)
Versioned authenticated ASGI research-job API, owner-derived read/write scopes, bounded request admission, readiness, OpenAPI and typed SDK (PR-047)

Hash-locked CPU dependency/build profiles, two-snapshot wheel rebuild checks, dependency SBOM and encrypted verified local snapshot/restore with lease fencing (PR-048; no container/offsite/production acceptance)
scope_prohibited: Live trading, order routing, or any connection to a brokerage
Use of real (non-synthetic) market or portfolio data
Any claim of regulatory, model-risk, or security certification

mixture_study.bank_weighting: equal probability per macro bank and equal conditional path weights
mixture_study.comparison_family: mixture endpoint: all declared scenario/contrast pairs

conditional_study.decision_rule: All scenario primary-contrast intervals must exceed the economic margin in the same direction; otherwise inconclusive.
limitations: Synthetic one-firm macro economy and GBM; no empirical or optimal-policy claim.
Current rate is the only extra feature; this is not a full macro-history encoder.
Training samples a finite mixture of independently generated macro paths, not the population.
Cell CVaR conditions on one held-out macro path; mean cell differences are not pooled CVaR.
Crossed percentile intervals have uncalibrated small-seed coverage; no exact guarantee.
Nominal Bonferroni allocation covers all scenario/contrast pairs; no marginal calibration.
Matched architecture, initialization and minibatches do not prove learned-feature usefulness.
Delta uses only current rates and fixed pricing volatility, assuming flat rates to expiry.
Economic and hedge books remain separate and the economy has no asset-wealth feedback.
No signed source identity, dependency lock, scientific review or deployment approval.

mixture_study.decision_rule: All primary-contrast nested intervals must exceed the economic margin in the same direction; otherwise inconclusive.
limitations: Empirical equal-weight macro-bank mixture, not calibrated unconditional population tail risk.
CVaR pools macro/market outcomes within a fitted policy; it never pools trained policies.
Few macro/training levels make percentile coverage unreliable; no exact guarantee.
Nested resampling uses macro banks and inner markets; finite-cluster calibration is absent.
Single-axis intervals are conditional diagnostics, not additive variance components.
Nominal Bonferroni allocation covers only new mixture scenario/contrast pairs.
Original conditional-risk intervals remain auxiliary and have a separate comparison family.
Matched rate-feature training is synthetic and uncalibrated; no optimal-policy claim.
No empirical macro probabilities, historical data, independent review or deployment approval.
mixture_study.resampling: training rows x macro banks x paired markets within each bank occurrence

model_cards.input_schema_summary: float32 (log-moneyness, remaining fraction, previous holding, (current_rate - 0.03) / 0.1); fourth feature replaced by zero; no future inputs.
model_cards.intended_use: Synthetic matched rate-feature ablation for single-asset option hedging.
model_cards.metric_uncertainty_note: One fitted model's empirical macro-mixture CVaR; nested study intervals resample shared rows/banks/markets. Original conditional metrics are auxiliary.
model_cards.model_type: 4-input MLP; two hidden layers of 32; tanh scalar holding in [-1,1]
model_cards.prohibited_use: Live trading, real-money decisions or unvalidated model families.
model_cards.training_data_summary: 1500 paths from independent training macro banks; path seed 1, policy seed 0; training scenario training_baseline; identical data for both arms.
